title: Mixed Speed Session
description: A mixed-intensity session combining steady swimming, pace changes and short, high-intensity efforts.

steps.description: Warm up: 50m front crawl, 50m breast stroke, 50m front crawl, 50m back stroke.
75m easy, followed by 25m fast. Repeat for 200m.

title: Pyramid
description: A controlled endurance session using a pyramid structure. Keep the same steady pace throughout all of the main efforts.

steps.description: Warm up: 50m front crawl, 50m breast stroke, 50m front crawl, 50m back stroke.
Steady pace. Aim to maintain the same pace as the first 100m.

title: Interval Speed Session
description: A mixed-intensity session designed to work on speed, recovery and the ability to hold a strong pace over repeated efforts.

steps.description: Warm up: 50m front crawl, 50m breast stroke, 50m front crawl, 50m back stroke.
8 x 50m. Swim the first 25m steady and the second 25m fast.
8 x 50m at a strong, controlled pace. Aim to keep every 50m at the same pace.
6 x 50m fast. Aim for a consistent pace across all six repetitions.

title: Endurance Builder
description: A steady aerobic session focused on building swim endurance and maintaining an even pace over longer distances.

steps.description: Warm up: 50m front crawl, 50m breast stroke, 50m front crawl, 50m back stroke.
3 x 200m at a steady aerobic pace. Try to make each 200m slightly faster than the previous one without sprinting the final effort.
4 x 200m at a consistent race-style effort. Focus on smooth technique and holding the same pace throughout.
Continuous 400m. Start comfortably and gradually increase the effort over the final 100m.
